facts.text: I am looking for advice on dog dental care.
I want recommendations for dog toothpastes and brushes that are gentle on a dog's gums.
I have been using a toothbrush from the vet's office.
I have a dog named Max.
I think I will go with the Oxyfresh Pet Toothbrush.
I have heard good things about the Oxyfresh brand.
I believe the ultra-soft bristles on the Oxyfresh Pet Toothbrush would be gentle on Max's gums.
I want to know the best way to store the toothbrush and toothpaste to keep them clean and prevent bacterial growth.
I am concerned about Max's dental chews.
I have been giving Max a few dental chews a day.
I am not sure whether Max should be given more or less dental chews.
I am thinking of switching Max to a different type of dental chew.
I have heard bully sticks can be high in fat and calories.
I want low-fat or low-calorie dental chews recommendations for Max.
